t: You are looking at the Church of St Barnabas in Pimlico, a Grade I listed Church of England parish church. It is known for its Anglo-Catholic tradition. It has been described as the first church built in England where the ideals and beliefs of the Anglo-Catholic movement were embodied in its architecture and liturgy. The architect was Thomas Cundy, surveyor of the Grosvenor Estate. He held that post during the main phase of the building of Belgravia and Pimlico by the contractor Thomas Cubitt.
